value.syntax: # [doc = " Supplied public and protected-capability validity facts; the process adapter owns their acquisition."] # [doc = " (´[ROOT-amend:api:health-lifecycle]´)"] # [expect (clippy :: struct_excessive_bools)] pub struct PreparationFacts < 'a > { # [doc = " Command arguments, including the program name."] pub arguments : & 'a [& 'a str] , # [doc = " Presence and public value of `PN_EDITION`."] pub edition : Option < & 'a str > , # [doc = " Presence and public value of `PN_EDITION_FILE`."] pub edition_file : Option < & 'a str > , # [doc = " The designated file's bounded bytes, if read successfully as a regular file."] pub file_bytes : Option < & 'a [u8] > , # [doc = " `LISTEN_PID` metadata."] pub listen_pid : Option < & 'a str > , # [doc = " `LISTEN_FDS` metadata."] pub listen_fds : Option < & 'a str > , # [doc = " `LISTEN_FDNAMES` metadata."] pub listen_fdnames : Option < & 'a str > , # [doc = " Presence of `LISTEN_PIDFDID`, including an empty value."] pub listen_pidfdid : bool , # [doc = " Presence of `PN_CONNECTION_INPUT`, including an empty value."] pub connection_input : bool , # [doc = " The current process identifier supplied by the adapter."] pub process_id : u32 , # [doc = " Whether the protected notification capability was supplied for start."] pub notification_present : bool , # [doc = " Whether the adapter admitted its private absolute filesystem address form."] pub notification_form_valid : bool , # [doc = " Whether the protected endpoint's final component is a symlink."] pub notification_final_symlink : bool , # [doc = " Whether the protected endpoint is a socket."] pub notification_is_socket : bool , }
